result.summary: The pedestrian environment includes basic infrastructure such as sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals at a signalized intersection. However, safety is reduced by poor pavement quality in the crossing area and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the corners.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are located very close to the crosswalk, obstructing the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street leading up to the intersection.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: The asphalt within the marked crosswalk is cracked and worn, creating potential trip hazards.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Crosswalk Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the crosswalk to provide a smooth and accessible path for pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows an urban street with a wide but uneven sidewalk and mixed-use buildings. Pedestrian safety is compromised by a lack of marked crossings, utility poles obstructing the walkway, and parked cars that limit visibility at the curb.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is situated in the middle of the sidewalk, narrowing the effective walking width.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

hazards.name: Tripping Hazard
hazards.description: The concrete sidewalk slabs are cracked and uneven in several places.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at intersections to improve visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility continental crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Level and repair cracked sidewalk slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible path.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals, providing a basic level of safety. However, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near the crossing points create potential visibility issues and increase exposure time for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street approaching the intersection.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: The main zebra crosswalk spanning the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and continuous sidewalks in a mixed-use urban environment. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the presence of parked cars near the crossing points create potential visibility and safety gaps for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement Surface
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crosswalk area could present a minor tripping hazard or reduced traction.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clearer information to people crossing.
